a_lire: Sagouindupm | VIctory: the single source of the Series S settings.
Read by series-s/reglages.ps1 (console launcher Sagouindupm.ps1) and by the graphical launcher (launcher/):
a setting changed here applies to both. The measuring scripts (scripts/bench) call victory.exe directly
and do not read this file. The notes explain each group; only the env values count.
The texts the launchers show (titre, note of the groups, nom, avertissement, conseil, sans_avx2, profil,
mesure, the notes of petite_ram and dlss) stay in French here: they are the French window's texts. The
English ones live in the graphical launcher and in reglages.ps1, matched by id. The other notes are in English.
profil: Base trustno1-coder/VIctory-NVIDIA réglée pour RTX 3060 par Maykzera, mesurée ici sur RTX 3050 8 Go + i5-12400F : ~84 ms par image (11,8 fps) dans la cinématique du bateau, eau et visages fidèles.

groupes.note: Maykzera : moins de fils auxiliaires, 16 soumissions préparées ensemble ; 4 fils de traduction des listes et pas 5 (Maykzera, 2 mesures ; ici 87 ms contre 93, pire image 178 ms).
Une pipeline pas prête : 150 ms d'attente au plus (10 000 gelait l'image 12 s, avatarmanz #143).
Lumière de remplacement du ray tracing, NaN effacés, 540p + upscaler du jeu, interface Series S.
Chaque partie note les pipelines créées, pour « Construire les pipelines » (victory warm --used).

pipelines_sautees.note: The ~1,000 ray tracing resolve passes (no ray structure on NVIDIA, file below, relative to the repository root), then the heat haze 731a39171b568298 (foxhound: it smears blocks of pixels, on the water too): 84 ms against 93 on an RTX 3050, clean picture. Then the programs that the LDS fallback (#27) makes translatable but that cost ~30 ms without the trees (water volumetrics 5dc3, underwater 926c, transmission 1f1f, 21f7, 7c9a); the trees stay. Then 43 ray-tracing-only work passes (bvh skinning, Primary_GatherCopy; Dathinel/victory-4gb issue #4, also in Proudnoob4's rt_work_off_hashes.txt): 88-89 ms against 91-92 in two clean A/B rounds, same picture. The water local-lights volumetrics 6f22 runs again, wave-wide (VICTORY_WAVE_WIDE_DIGESTS, from edupode): 92 ms against 103, clean water.

pipelines_partagees.note: The shared pipeline list (keys, shader hashes, states: no game code), relative to the root. Both launchers import it before the shader translation (victory pipelines import <list>: the translation keeps along the way the shaders it names), or after it with --shaders <the player's shaders>, then victory warm --used: the first session no longer stutters until after the boat mission. The "name:size" mark in lanceur.json (pipelines_liste) says which list was built.

petite_ram.note: PC à moins de 24 Go : fenêtres de mémoire du jeu dans la mémoire de la carte (évite le plantage 0x8007000E).

jeu.note: A complete copy of the game, not the exe alone: game_scarlett_master.exe with its archives next to it (v1.0.2.1: ~130 GB, 12 .rpf archives including shaders.rpf and levels.rpf, ~25,000 translated shaders). The automatic search prefers complete copies; an incomplete copy is refused with what is missing. After the translation, fewer than shaders_min shaders means an incomplete copy.
jeu.conseil: Gardez toute la copie du jeu dans son propre dossier (par exemple C:\Jeux\GTA6), pas en vrac dans Téléchargements.

materiel.note: Profile picked automatically from this PC, without asking: the CPU, the card then the RAM adjust the settings of the groups (in that order), before the 24 GB rule. The reference PC (RTX 3050 8 GB, 12 threads, 32 GB) keeps exactly the settings of the groups.

processeur.note: Helper threads according to the CPU's logical cores (threads).

carte.note: Card buffers according to its memory. Never 2048 MB under 11 GB (3 fps measured on 8 GB cards with 2 GB of buffers): a 10 GB card stays at 1024 like 8 GB (64 KiB buffers on the card, 1024 MB of them and 1280 MB of room for render targets: 75 ms against 93 on the RTX 3050, card refusals 67 -> 15, characters textured). VICTORY_TEXTURE_MAX only counts once PR #30 is merged; unknown to the engine before that, it has no effect. Card memory unknown: the settings of the groups.

tres_petite_ram.note: 16 GB PC (under 20 GB): on top of the 24 GB rule, helper threads one step lower and card buffers at 1024 MB at most.
tres_petite_ram.conseil: 16 Go de mémoire vive : fermez le navigateur, Discord et les autres programmes avant de jouer.

amd.avertissement: Carte AMD : non testé, profil Series S générique. Vos mesures nous aident.

intel_arc.avertissement: Carte Intel Arc : non testé, profil Series S générique. Vos mesures nous aident.

intel_integree.avertissement: Puce graphique intégrée : il faut une carte graphique dédiée de 4 Go ou plus.

materiel.sans_avx2: Processeur sans AVX2 : la version téléchargeable de VIctory ne démarrera pas. Compilez-la depuis les sources (voir le README).

dlss.note: DLSS (cartes RTX) à la place de l'upscaler du jeu, si le dossier de Streamline est donné et le mode n'est pas « off ». Mesuré sur RTX 3050 : ultra performance 90 ms (image propre), performance 102 ms, qualité 176 ms.

modes.mesure: 90 ms par image sur RTX 3050, image propre

petite_vram.note: Low video memory mode (an option of both launchers, off by default), for 6 GB cards or black screens: smaller textures, fewer card buffers and less room for render targets, applied over the card's profile. Recommended, not forced, when the card has less than conseille_sous_go GB (6 GB or less).

framegen.note: Frame generation (an option of both launchers, off by default): about twice the frames shown, the input lag of the real ones. NVIDIA's DLSS-G through Streamline (crates/victory-gpu/src/ffx/framegen.rs): on RTX 40/50 NVIDIA's own, on RTX 20/30 and GTX 16 FSR 3 behind DLSS-G's calls (dlssg-to-fsr3, Nukem9, GPL-3.0, the fg folder of the downloadable package); not offered on other cards yet. Applied after the card's profile and the low video memory mode, when the folder (dossier, under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Sagouindupm) holds the files frame generation needs (fichiers_requis): env, the caps (plafonds: the lower of the value so far and the cap), the folder in variable_dossier, and without DLSS super resolution sans_dlss. With DLSS super resolution Streamline is loaded once from VICTORY_DLSS_DIR, which must then hold both: the folder replaces the DLSS folder (if it holds fichiers_dlss). Measured on RTX 3050 8 GB, boat mission: frame generation alone 85 ms per real frame but 189 card refusals ('no room', black objects); with CARD_BUFFERS_MB=768 and TEXTURE_ROOM_PERCENT=90 91 ms, 7 refusals, characters textured (kept). TEXTURE_MAX=2048 on top: 89 ms, 2 refusals but a 5.9 s hitch (not kept). POOL_FULLEST alone: 105 ms against 88 (rejected).

streamline.note: NVIDIA Streamline, fetched by series-s/framegen.ps1 from NVIDIA's own release on GitHub (only the files below are taken out of the archive), each DLL checked against its SHA-256. NVIDIA's licence does not let us ship them: never in the repository or the package.

fsr3.note: dlssg-to-fsr3 (Nukem9, GPL-3.0), built from source (commit 0e253f63) into the fg folder of the downloadable package. Copied next to engine\victory.exe and into the folder before a session with frame generation on an RTX 20/30 or GTX 16 card (Streamline's sl.interposer.dll imports dbghelp.dll, the mod's loader), and taken away otherwise.

shaders.note: The card's facts for the shader translation (NVIDIA: waves of 32, 1,000,000 views): without them the cache is useless in game. Threads: all logical cores but two (at least 2).
